title: YouTube License Metadata with FlashData
description: Enter the required video_id input and your own FlashData API key below. Optional settings can be left unchanged. Click Start to run one YouTube License Metadata request, then open the run’s Dataset for results or OUTPUT for the complete JSON response. FlashData Credits and Apify resource usage are billed separately; no Actor service fee is added.

video_id.title: Video Id
video_id.description: Paste one 11-character YouTube video ID. For https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=abcdefghijk, copy only abcdefghijk (illustrative ID; replace it with your video). Full URLs and lists are not accepted.

flashdataApiKey.title: Your FlashData API key
flashdataApiKey.description: In your FlashData account dashboard, open API Keys and create or copy a key with YouTube License Metadata (youtube_trainability) permission. Paste the full key starting with fd_ here, without quotes or a Bearer prefix. Use your own FlashData key, not your Apify token. This field is encrypted; no working key is provided. Clicking Start uses your FlashData Credits.
